rationale: Direct accepted and promoted 639704-gas predecessor at source commit 5c568209d9e85d4e9e7add1b9c87978d9e40f6db. The complete 9742-byte implementation, resident-key fold, recognizers, generic RIPEMD-160 compressor, serialization, and exact-byte proof structure are inherited from this predecessor. This candidate changes only the tiny-guard miss destination from the unchanged PC 4905 forwarding block to that block's unchanged PC 245 target and updates the affected exact-code and gas-path proof terms.
evidence: The predecessor decodes to SHA-256 b844e471494039d3daed485682178156e0602a84e6b213cc6463d85130bd8cec. The candidate changes bytecode offsets 4704 and 4705 from 0x13,0x29 to 0x00,0xf5, preserves 9742 bytes and 5411 instruction boundaries, and decodes to SHA-256 773623f8117ad3081664cbe812e4d7fdf14fe0a27366209cde18ed35f3147f2d. The target at PC 245 is instruction index 125 and remains JUMPDEST; the skipped forwarding sequence at PCs 4905, 4906, and 4908 remains JUMPDEST, PUSH1 245, JUMP. Earlier lineage is inherited through the predecessor dependency DAG.
